import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    orders = inputs["orders"].copy()
    price_list = inputs["price_list"].copy()

    # --- expression: sku_norm ---
    orders["sku_norm"] = orders["sku"].astype("string").str.strip().str.upper()
    orders["sku_norm"] = orders["sku_norm"].where(orders["sku"].notna(), other=pd.NA)

    price_list["sku_norm_pl"] = price_list["sku"].astype("string").str.strip().str.upper()

    orders["_idx"] = orders.index

    # --- lookup ---
    merged = orders.merge(
        price_list,
        left_on="sku_norm",
        right_on="sku_norm_pl",
        how="left",
        suffixes=("", "_pl"),
    )

    valid_mask = merged["valid_from"].notna() & (merged["valid_from"] <= merged["order_date"])
    matches = merged[valid_mask].copy()

    if not matches.empty:
        matches = matches.sort_values(
            ["valid_from", "list_id"], ascending=[False, True]
        )
        best = matches.drop_duplicates(subset="_idx", keep="first")
    else:
        best = matches

    best_small = best[["_idx", "unit_price"]].copy()

    orders_final = orders.merge(best_small, on="_idx", how="left", suffixes=("", "_best"))

    orders_final["price_flag"] = np.where(
        orders_final["unit_price"].notna(), "OK", "NO_PRICE"
    )
    orders_final["unit_price"] = orders_final["unit_price"].fillna(0.0)

    # --- expression: ext_amount ---
    orders_final["ext_amount"] = orders_final["qty"] * orders_final["unit_price"]
    orders_final.loc[orders_final["qty"].isna(), "ext_amount"] = np.nan

    # --- router ---
    qty = orders_final["qty"]
    price_flag = orders_final["price_flag"]
    ext_amount = orders_final["ext_amount"]

    rule1 = (price_flag == "NO_PRICE") | qty.isna() | (qty >= 100)
    rule2 = ext_amount >= 1000
    rule3 = ext_amount < 50

    rule1 = rule1.fillna(False)
    rule2 = rule2.fillna(False)
    rule3 = rule3.fillna(False)

    route = np.select(
        [rule1.to_numpy(), rule2.to_numpy(), rule3.to_numpy()],
        ["REVIEW", "BULK", "SMALL"],
        default="STANDARD",
    )
    orders_final["route"] = route

    # --- output1: order_enriched ---
    order_enriched = orders_final[["order_id", "sku_norm", "unit_price", "route"]].copy()

    # --- aggregator ---
    grouped = orders_final.groupby(["route", "order_date"], dropna=False).agg(
        order_count=("order_id", "size"),
        total_ext=("ext_amount", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()

    grouped["total_ext"] = grouped["total_ext"].fillna(0.0)

    route_daily = grouped[["route", "order_date", "order_count", "total_ext"]]

    return {
        "order_enriched": order_enriched,
        "route_daily": route_daily,
    }
